The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 499df173e9f8ba2d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 14-15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let B◦ be a smooth irreducible complex quasi- projective variety, and let V be a polarizable rational pure variation with an invariant integral lattice. Suppose that a line bundle L has a generically nonzero algebraic morphism u : L −→ Fp VC, Fp+1 VC = 0. There are a positive integer a, a homogeneous tensor construction followed by flat Hodge- compatible projections, and a generically nonzero morphism u∗ : L⊗a −→ E0, E0 = Fp∗ A, Fp∗+1 A = 0, (4.1) where A is a polarized complex pure variation. The operations may first be performed equivariantly at finite monodromy level. They descend to B◦ after shrinking it. On smooth projective birational models there is a dominant morphism b : B → S with connected fibers and the following properties. (i) Descent. On dense smooth opens, A is the pullback of an actual variation on S◦. Its connected representation is irreducible and factors through a rational semisimple adjoint group G. The full monodromy acts through its projected action on g = Lie G. In particular, finite scalar monodromy in the kernel of that action has been eliminated. (ii) The marks. There is an algebraic compact-flag section ju, possibly empty, determined pointwise and equivariantly by [u∗]. In flat coordinates the joint marks j = (E0, ju) take values in a closed product flag orbit J of GC. The two kinds of marks use disjoint complex simple factors. Every rational simple factor of G has a complex factor acting nontrivially on J. The full Lie-period map together with ju is generically immersive on S◦. (iii) The nef lines and adjoint positivity. If S is a point, A is constant and we set H = Hu = 0. Otherwise S has nef rational line bundles H and Hu, with H − Hu nef. On a smooth unipotent connected-monodromy cover their pullbacks are respectively det E0 + Hu and the positive compact-flag line. The generic curvature rank of H is the generic rank of dj, and equals ν(H). If D0 denotes the reduced union of boundary components with nonidentity local monodromy on g, then KS + D0 + cHu is big for c ≫ 0. (4.2) Furthermore, KS + b0H is big for b0 ≫ 0. (4.3) REVERSE LOGARITHMIC KODAIRA INEQUALITY 15 All assertions about extensions are compatible with further smooth projective modifications and pullback at unipotent level. In particular, the iterated Higgs fields of u∗ are polynomial tensor expressions in those of u; the construction introduces no division by a local function.
